title: Console pathway: workspace cards, cost lenses & rollout handoff
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Console navigation and workspace switching currently fractures the user journey between monitoring (dashboards), deployment rollouts, and cost analysis. Engineers and PMs move between three mental models: pipelines, capacity, and cost. This ticket scopes a consolidated pathway pattern — lightweight workspace cards plus an expandable cost-lens and rollout handoff panel — that reduces context-switching and surfaces operational signals earlier in the workflow.

Goal: Deliver a design spec and high-fidelity prototype that: 1) replaces the dense list-based workspace picker with context-rich cards; 2) integrates a right-hand cost-lens (token + GPU cost) on dashboard pages; 3) exposes rollout handoff controls (canary percentage, fallback model, timeframe) from the same surface; 4) ensures keyboard accessibility, reduced visual clutter, and mobile-adaptive behavior.

Scope: IA changes (sidebar shortcuts + route conventions), workspace card templates (pinned, recent, shared), cost-lens visual language and micro-interactions, rollout handoff modal/panel, and telemetry hooks for Console UX analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace switcher shows cards with 3 metadata fields (name, owner/team, last deployment) and supports keyboard navigation and quick actions (Open, Duplicate, Open Cost Lens)
Cost lens surfaces per-route token burn rate and projected hourly GPU cost with 3-tier granularity (estimate, variance, top contributors) and a concise explainer tooltip
Rollout handoff panel allows editing canary percent, selecting fallback model, setting rollout window, and has clear validation and undo affordances
Routes and breadcrumbs are documented with backwards-compatible aliases for existing bookmarked links
Prototype includes microcopy for uncertain states (no cost data, delayed telemetry) and an admin mode for Dedicated/Private customers
Design spec includes accessibility notes (tab order, ARIA labels, contrast ratios) and QA checklist for keyboard/screen reader flows
decisions: Use card-first workspace switcher to surface deployment metadata; will replace compact list only for users with < 30 workspaces to avoid long scrolls
Cost lens will be rendered client-side with aggregated metrics from Console telemetry API; for Private deployments we add a toggle to respect data locality
Rollout handoff will be a persistent slide-over on desktop and a modal on mobile to keep the primary routing intact
Keep primary sidebar reduced to 6 top-level routes; other routes accessible via command palette to reduce visual noise
dev_notes: Frontend: Sidebar routing changes require a backwards-compatible alias table; ENG to add redirect middleware for old routes
Backend: Telemetry endpoints for cost breakdown already exist under /api/telemetry/usage but need an hourly-aggregates endpoint for the lens
Privacy: Private deployments should default to 'local-only' cost telemetry; add feature flag to Console config
Performance: Cost lens must render incrementally — show cached last-known values and then patch with live aggregates
